CVE-2026-22879.title: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the vtkDICOM ...
CVE-2026-22879.description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the vtkDICOMItem::FindDataElementOrInsert functionality of vtk-dicom (version(s): 9.5.2). A specially crafted DICOM file can lead to heap-based memory corruption. An attacker can provide a malicious file to trigger this vulnerability.
